app.title: WinQStep
template.hint.dispersion_disabled: DFT-D3 parameters are hidden and will not be rendered unless DFT-D3 is checked.
template.hint.dispersion_enabled: DFT-D3 will be rendered with the selected type, parameter file, and reference functional.
template.hint.dispersion_missing: DFT-D3 is enabled; choose a type, parameter file, and reference functional.
template.hint.outer_scf_disabled: OUTER_SCF controls are hidden and will not be rendered unless Outer SCF is checked.
template.hint.outer_scf_enabled: OUTER_SCF will be rendered with its own EPS_SCF and MAX_SCF controls.
template.hint.outer_scf_missing: Outer SCF is enabled; fill both Outer EPS SCF and Outer Max SCF.
template.hint.mixing_disabled: MIXING controls are hidden and will not be rendered unless Mixing is checked.
template.hint.mixing_enabled: MIXING will be rendered. It is valid only with SCF Method DIAGONALIZATION.
template.hint.mixing_scf_method: Mixing is enabled but requires SCF Method DIAGONALIZATION.
template.hint.mixing_missing: Mixing is enabled; choose a mixing method and parameters.
template.hint.smearing_disabled: SMEAR controls are hidden and will not be rendered unless Smearing is checked.
template.hint.smearing_enabled: SMEAR will be rendered. It requires DIAGONALIZATION and added MOs.
template.hint.smearing_scf_method: Smearing is enabled but requires SCF Method DIAGONALIZATION.
template.hint.smearing_added_mos: Smearing is enabled but Added MOs must be greater than zero.
template.hint.smearing_missing: Smearing is enabled; choose a smearing method and electronic temperature.
template.hint.poisson_default: No explicit POISSON_SOLVER is selected; CP2K default is used with the resolved periodicity.
template.hint.poisson_selected: Selected POISSON_SOLVER is compatible with the visible Cell Periodic value.
template.hint.poisson_incompatible: Selected POISSON_SOLVER is not compatible with the visible Cell Periodic value.
template.hint.kpoints_none: KPOINTS details are hidden because scheme is NONE; no KPOINTS section will be rendered.
template.hint.kpoints_nonperiodic: KPOINTS are disabled because Cell Periodic is NONE.
template.hint.kpoints_gamma: KPOINTS will render SCHEME GAMMA. Grid controls are hidden because they only apply to MONKHORST-PACK.
template.hint.kpoints_monkhorst_pack: KPOINTS will render SCHEME MONKHORST-PACK with the selected grid.
template.hint.kpoints_missing_grid: MONKHORST-PACK is selected; fill a KPOINTS grid such as 1 1 1.
template.hint.kpoints_unknown: KPOINTS scheme is not recognized; choose NONE, GAMMA, or MONKHORST-PACK.
template.hint.print_none: No DFT PRINT outputs are selected.
template.hint.print_selected: Selected DFT PRINT sections will be rendered and collected as artifacts when CP2K writes files.
template.hint.print_band_missing: Band Structure is enabled; fill the output file, NPOINTS, units, and at least two special k-points.
template.hint.print_band_nonperiodic: Band Structure is disabled because Cell Periodic is NONE.
template.hint.cell_opt_inactive: CELL_OPT controls are ignored unless Run Type is CELL_OPT.
template.hint.cell_opt_active: CELL_OPT will render analytic stress tensor and the current CELL_OPT controls.
template.hint.cell_opt_nonperiodic: CELL_OPT requires a periodic cell; Cell Periodic NONE will fail for nonperiodic or fallback-cell structures.
